author: Deeesp
body:
Hello. I'm really sorry I am trying to appeal my ban again, I am not trying to spam. I saw my first ban is appealed, and thank you, but I got banned again for "Ban Evasion". I don't even know what happened, I didn't join your server the last two days, because I was banned, how can I get banned, again, for Ban Evasion? It is impossible! Please, if you can, do something about it.
Thank you, CoCo_Debby.
